headline: On 20 held-out seeds in simulated Indian mixed traffic, CHOWK showed no clear difference in delay per person versus area max-pressure (+0.1%, 95% CI −0.4% to +0.5%), with 2.8% lower delay versus Webster fixed-time (95% CI −3.2% to −2.3%). Simulation result.
